strings: m_c wheezes to r_c0 that it feels like a cat is sitting on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chest. r_c0 waves fragrant herbs beneath m_c's nose, praying this breathlessness will not progress to suffocation.
m_c is used to being breathless, but today {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can hardly walk a few fox-lengths before growing faint. Something in the air must have irritated {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} lungs.
